## USA TODAY Co. Announces Appointment of Independent Director to Board of Directors


September 15, 2026


*Babbel Chief Executive Officer Tim Allen Appointed to the Board*


[USA TODAY Co., Inc.](http://www.usatodayco.com/) (“USA TODAY Co.”, “we”, “us”, “our”, or the “Company”) (NYSE: TDAY) today announced that its Board of Directors has appointed Tim Allen, Chief Executive Officer of Babbel, to the Company’s Board of Directors.


“We are pleased to announce Tim’s appointment and excited to welcome him to the Board. Tim brings an exceptional combination of leadership, digital innovation expertise, and consumer-focused growth experience,” said Michael Reed, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of USA TODAY Co. “Tim’s deep understanding of subscription and direct-to-consumer business models, and track record leveraging technology and AI to drive growth and deepen customer engagement will be invaluable as we continue expanding our digital opportunities. I look forward to his valuable perspective as a member of the USA TODAY Co. Board.”


Allen is the Chief Executive Officer of Babbel, a global digital language-learning company, where he leads the company’s global strategy, operations, and next phase of growth, including the thoughtful integration of AI to enhance customer experiences. For more than two decades across technology, digital media, subscription businesses, and consumer platforms, Allen has built a reputation for driving growth, fostering innovation, and creating customer-centric products and experiences at scale. Prior to joining Babbel, Allen served as Chief Executive Officer of Care.com and Ask.com, held the position of Vice President of Program Management and Operations at Ask.com, and served as General Manager of Product Management at Vimeo, where he helped scale global consumer technology platforms and drive product innovation.


“I am honored to join the USA TODAY Co. Board at this important moment in the Company’s evolution,” said Allen. “With its portfolio of trusted local brands, national reach and longstanding commitment to innovation, I believe USA TODAY Co. is uniquely positioned for long-term success. I look forward to partnering with the Board and leadership team to help advance the Company’s growth strategy, strengthen its service to communities and create value for shareholders.”
